_readme: Central exercise list. The app loads this file every time it opens. Edit video / startImage / endImage for any exercise. Values can be a plain file name (e.g. leg-press.mp4 - looked up in videoBase / imageBase below), a full https:// link, or ./path (relative to the app page). videoBase points at your 'Media For App' release using GitHub's 'latest' link, so it works whatever the release's tag is - but it must be your NEWEST published release (not a draft or pre-release). Type the video's file name EXACTLY as it is listed under Assets on the release page - GitHub changes some characters (spaces and hyphens can become dots), so 'overhead-tricep-extension.mp4' may show as 'overhead.tricep.extension.mp4'. To share one video across variations (e.g. Leg Press and Single-Leg Leg Press), type the same video file name in both entries and give each its own startImage/endImage. 'oldYoutube' is the exercise's YouTube link: the app uses it ONLY when the exercise has no 'video' from your release. As soon as you add a 'video' file name, the release video (and start/end photos) take over and YouTube is no longer shown. Squat and Goblet Squat use TEST media in ./media/ - replace them. 'aliases' lists other names for the same exercise (e.g. a program that says 'Overhead Tricep Extension' still gets the Overhead Tricep Stretch video and photos). Overhead Tricep video is served from the repo media folder (./media/overhead-tricep-extension.mp4) because that plays reliably on every phone; videos on the release can be blocked by some phones.

exercises.name: Squat
exercises.desc: Stand feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly out. Lower hips until thighs are parallel to floor, keeping chest tall and knees tracking over toes. Drive through heels to return. Keep core braced throughout.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.desc: Hold a weight at chest height. Feet shoulder-width, squat deep, keeping elbows inside knees at the bottom. Chest tall, heels down.

exercises.name: Split Squat
exercises.desc: Stand in a long lunge stance, both feet facing forward. Lower back knee toward the floor, keeping front shin vertical. Drive through front heel to return.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.desc: Rear foot elevated on a bench, front foot forward. Lower until front thigh is parallel to floor. Keep torso upright and front knee over toes.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.desc: Hinge at hips with slight knee bend, pushing hips back as bar/weights lower toward mid-shin. Maintain neutral spine throughout. Drive hips forward to return.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
exercises.desc: Balance on one leg, hinge forward at hip while rear leg extends. Keep hips level and spine neutral. Return to upright without touching down.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust
exercises.desc: Shoulders on bench, feet flat, bar across hips. Drive hips to full extension, squeezing glutes at top. Control the descent.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
exercises.desc: Lie supine, knees bent, feet flat. Drive hips to full extension squeezing glutes, hold briefly, then lower. Keep ribs down.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
exercises.desc: Supine with one knee bent, other leg extended. Drive hips up through the planted foot. Keep pelvis level throughout.

exercises.name: Step Up
exercises.desc: Step onto a box with one foot, drive through that heel to stand fully. Step down with control. Keep torso upright throughout.

exercises.name: Lateral Step Up
exercises.desc: Stand beside the box, step up sideways with the leading foot, driving through the hip and glute. Step down with control.

exercises.name: Calf Raise (Bilateral)
exercises.desc: Stand at edge of step or flat surface. Rise onto toes, fully extending ankles, then lower with control below neutral.

exercises.name: Calf Raise (Single Leg)
exercises.desc: Balance on one foot at edge of step. Rise onto toes fully, then lower slowly with control. Use support if needed for balance.

exercises.name: Terminal Knee Extension
exercises.desc: Resistance band behind knee, stand on one leg with slight flex. Extend knee to full extension against band resistance, then return with control.

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.desc: Seated, feet shoulder-width on platform. Lower weight until knees are at 90°, then press through heels to extend. Do not lock knees at top.

exercises.name: Wall Squat (Isometric)
exercises.desc: Back flat against wall, slide down until knees are at 90°. Hold position with core engaged and knees over ankles. Maintain neutral spine.

exercises.name: Deadlift
exercises.desc: Bar over mid-foot, grip outside legs. Hinge to bar maintaining neutral spine, brace core. Drive floor away to stand, hips and shoulders rise together.

exercises.name: Clamshell
exercises.desc: Side-lying, hips stacked and bent to 45°. Keeping feet together, rotate top knee toward ceiling. Avoid rolling the pelvis back.

exercises.name: Mini-Band Walk (Lateral)
exercises.desc: Band around ankles, quarter-squat position. Step sideways maintaining tension in band, keeping toes forward and knees over toes.

exercises.name: Tibialis Raise
exercises.desc: Stand with heels on edge of step or against wall. Lift forefoot up toward shins as high as possible, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Seated Row (Cable)
exercises.desc: Seated upright, grip handles. Pull elbows back to sides squeezing shoulder blades together. Avoid leaning back excessively.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.desc: Seated under bar, grip wide. Pull bar to upper chest, driving elbows down. Avoid excessive lean-back; keep core engaged.

exercises.name: Chest Press (DB)
exercises.desc: Supine on bench, dumbbells at chest. Press straight up until arms extended, then lower with control, keeping elbows at 45°.

exercises.name: Shoulder Press (DB)
exercises.desc: Seated or standing, dumbbells at shoulder height. Press overhead until arms extended, then lower to start. Keep core braced.

exercises.name: Bicep Curl (DB)
exercises.desc: Stand, arms at sides. Curl dumbbells toward shoulders keeping elbows pinned at sides. Lower slowly with control.

exercises.name: Tricep Pushdown (Cable)
exercises.desc: Grip bar or rope at chest. Push down until arms fully extend, keeping upper arms still. Control the return.

exercises.name: Band Pull-Apart
exercises.desc: Hold band at shoulder height, arms straight. Pull apart horizontally until hands are level with shoulders, squeezing shoulder blades. Control the return.

exercises.name: Face Pull (Cable)
exercises.desc: Cable at face height, rope attachment. Pull toward face splitting the rope to ears, externally rotating shoulders. Pause at end range.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise
exercises.desc: Slight bend at elbow, raise dumbbells to shoulder height, leading with elbows. Lower slowly. Avoid shrugging or swinging.

exercises.name: External Rotation (Band)
exercises.desc: Elbow at 90° pinned at side. Rotate forearm outward against band resistance. Control the return to neutral.

exercises.name: Internal Rotation (Band)
exercises.desc: Elbow at 90° at side. Rotate forearm inward across body against band resistance. Control return to neutral.

exercises.name: Prone Y-T-W
exercises.desc: Lie prone. Perform three positions — Y (arms overhead 45°), T (arms out to sides), W (elbows bent 90°). Lift arms off ground each time.

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.desc: Plank position, hands shoulder-width. Lower chest to floor with elbows at 45° to body. Press back up maintaining rigid trunk.

exercises.name: Wall Push-Up
exercises.desc: Hands on wall, body angled. Bend elbows to bring chest toward wall, then push back. A reduced-load chest press variation suitable for all levels.

exercises.name: Wrist Flexion/Extension
exercises.desc: Seated, forearm resting on thigh. Curl wrist up then extend down through full range. Use light dumbbell or band.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
exercises.desc: Supine, arms toward ceiling, knees at 90°. Extend opposite arm and leg simultaneously while pressing lower back into floor. Exhale throughout.

exercises.name: Bird Dog
exercises.desc: On hands and knees, neutral spine. Extend opposite arm and leg, hold briefly, then return. Avoid hip rotation.

exercises.name: Plank (Prone)
exercises.desc: Forearms and toes, body straight. Brace core, squeeze glutes, keep hips level. Breathe normally throughout hold.

exercises.name: Side Plank
exercises.desc: Side-lying on forearm, body straight. Lift hips, maintaining alignment from head to feet. Place top hand on hip. Avoid sagging.

exercises.name: Pallof Press
exercises.desc: Standing perpendicular to cable. Press handle straight out from chest and return, resisting the rotation. Keep hips and shoulders square.

exercises.name: McGill Curl-Up
exercises.desc: Supine, one knee bent, hands under lumbar curve. Lift head and shoulders slightly without flattening lumbar spine. Isometric spine stabilisation.

exercises.name: Hollow Hold
exercises.desc: Supine, arms overhead, press lower back into floor. Raise arms, legs and shoulders slightly. Maintain position without breath-holding.

exercises.name: Suitcase Carry
exercises.desc: Hold weight in one hand at side, walk forward maintaining level pelvis and upright posture. Resist lateral trunk lean.

exercises.name: Hip Flexor Stretch
exercises.desc: Half-kneeling position, front foot forward. Tuck pelvis slightly and shift weight forward until stretch felt in front of rear hip. Avoid overextending lumbar.

exercises.name: Hamstring Stretch (Supine)
exercises.desc: Lie on back, lift one leg keeping knee straight. Hold behind thigh or use a strap. Avoid rounding the lower back.

exercises.name: Pigeon Pose (Glute Stretch)
exercises.desc: From a lunge, bring front shin across body and lower hips toward floor. Keep hips level and avoid rotating the pelvis. Breathe into stretch.

exercises.name: Cat-Cow
exercises.desc: On hands and knees. Alternately arch and round the spine through its full range. Move slowly and breathe with each movement.

exercises.name: Thoracic Extension (Foam Roller)
exercises.desc: Position foam roller horizontally under thoracic spine. Support head with hands, allow upper back to extend over roller. Breathe out and relax.

exercises.name: Child's Pose
exercises.desc: Kneel, sit back toward heels, reach arms forward. Relax the chest toward the floor. Breathe into the lower back and between shoulder blades.

exercises.name: Quad Stretch (Standing)
exercises.desc: Stand on one leg, pull opposite foot toward buttock. Keep knees together, stand tall. Use support if needed for balance.

exercises.name: Calf Stretch (Wall)
exercises.desc: Hands on wall, one foot back with heel flat. Keep rear knee straight for gastrocnemius; bend slightly for soleus. Lean forward gently.

exercises.name: Single Leg Stance
exercises.desc: Stand on one leg, maintaining a level pelvis and upright posture. Progress by reducing hand support, closing eyes, or using an unstable surface.

exercises.name: Single Leg Stance (Eyes Closed)
exercises.desc: Stand on one leg, close eyes. Maintain balance by focusing on ankle and hip proprioceptors. Stand near support for safety.

exercises.name: Tandem Walk
exercises.desc: Walk forward placing each foot directly in front of the other, heel to toe. Arms may be extended for balance.

exercises.name: Star Excursion (Y-Balance)
exercises.desc: Stand on one leg, reach the free foot to three target directions (anterior, posteromedial, posterolateral) as far as possible. Return to center between each reach.

exercises.name: Bosu Ball Squat
exercises.desc: Stand on dome side of BOSU, feet shoulder-width. Perform a controlled squat, maintaining balance throughout.

exercises.name: Stationary Bike (Moderate)
exercises.desc: Maintain a comfortable pace at 60-70% of maximum heart rate. Adjust seat so knee has slight bend at bottom of pedal stroke.

exercises.name: Stationary Bike (Interval)
exercises.desc: Alternate 30s high effort with 60-90s recovery throughout session. Monitor perceived exertion to guide intensity.

exercises.name: Treadmill Walk
exercises.desc: Maintain upright posture, arms swinging naturally. Target 3-4.5km/h or pace that allows comfortable conversation.

exercises.name: Rowing Machine
exercises.desc: Drive with legs first, then lean back slightly, then pull arms to lower chest. Reverse the order to return.

exercises.name: Elliptical Trainer
exercises.desc: Low-impact full-body exercise. Maintain upright posture, push and pull handles equally, keep light grip.

exercises.name: Step Machine
exercises.desc: Press through full foot, avoid hanging on handlebars. Maintain slight forward lean and controlled pace.

exercises.name: Swimming
exercises.desc: Freestyle or stroke of choice. Focus on bilateral breathing if freestyle, maintaining streamlined body position.

exercises.name: Sit-to-Stand (Chair)
exercises.desc: Sit at chair edge, feet flat shoulder-width. Lean slightly forward then drive through feet to stand fully. Reverse with control.

exercises.name: Timed Up-and-Go
exercises.desc: From seated, stand, walk 3m, turn, return and sit. Record time. Target under 12 seconds for community-dwelling adults.

exercises.name: Heel-Toe Walk
exercises.desc: Walk in a straight line placing the heel of each advancing foot directly in front of the toes of the rear foot.

exercises.name: Backwards Walk
exercises.desc: Walk backwards in a straight line. Progress by adding a cognitive task. Ensure clear space behind you for safety.

exercises.name: High Knee March
exercises.desc: March in place lifting each knee to hip height. Maintain upright posture with opposite arm swing. Control the descent.

exercises.name: Diaphragmatic Breathing
exercises.desc: Lie or sit comfortably. Breathe into the belly first, allowing it to rise. Exhale slowly. Avoid elevating shoulders on inhale.

exercises.name: Pursed Lip Breathing
exercises.desc: Inhale through nose for 2 counts. Exhale slowly through pursed lips for 4 counts. Helps slow breathing rate and reduce dyspnoea.

exercises.name: Post-Meal Walk
exercises.desc: Walk at comfortable pace within 30 minutes of a meal to aid glucose uptake. Monitor glucose if on insulin.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Circuit
exercises.desc: Complete a series of band exercises back-to-back with minimal rest to maintain elevated heart rate and metabolic demand.

exercises.name: Pelvic Tilts
exercises.desc: Supine with knees bent. Alternate between flattening and arching the lower back, focusing on isolated lumbar movement. Breathe with each tilt.

exercises.name: Swimming (Pilates)
exercises.desc: Prone, extend opposite arm and leg simultaneously off the floor, alternate rapidly in a flutter motion. Maintain core brace.

exercises.name: Heel Drop (Bone Loading)
exercises.desc: Stand on both feet, rise to toes then drop down quickly, creating a brief impact force. Maintain tall posture throughout.

exercises.name: Chin Tuck
exercises.desc: Sitting tall, gently draw chin straight back creating a double chin. Hold briefly, release. Avoid tilting the head.

exercises.name: Wall Angels
exercises.desc: Stand with back, head, and arms against wall. Slide arms overhead and back down like a snow angel, keeping all contact points.

exercises.name: Prone Cobra
exercises.desc: Lie prone, forehead down. Lift head, shoulders and chest, retracting shoulder blades. Arms can be at sides or Y-position. Hold briefly.

exercises.name: Seated Scapular Retraction
exercises.desc: Seated tall. Squeeze shoulder blades firmly together and hold, then release fully. Avoid shrugging or holding breath.

exercises.name: Neural Floss – Sciatic
exercises.desc: Seated, straighten one knee while dorsiflexing foot, then flex knee and plantarflex. Perform as a slow, rhythmic motion.

exercises.name: Neural Floss – Median Nerve
exercises.desc: Seated, extend arm at shoulder height, extend wrist. Alternately tilt head away and toward the arm. Perform smoothly without pain.

exercises.name: Slump Stretch
exercises.desc: Seated, slump into flexion, extend one knee with foot dorsiflexed. Hold or perform gentle oscillations at end of range if tolerated.

exercises.name: Box Jump (Low)
exercises.desc: Stand before a low box, dip slightly, swing arms and jump onto box with soft landing. Land with knees bent, absorbing force quietly.

exercises.name: Broad Jump
exercises.desc: Stand feet shoulder-width, dip and jump as far forward as possible with two feet. Land softly with knees bent. Measure for progression.

exercises.name: Lateral Bound
exercises.desc: Single-leg takeoff laterally, land on opposite foot with control, absorbing the force. Focus on soft, stable landing before exploding again.

exercises.name: Jogging (Treadmill)
exercises.desc: Begin at brisk walk, progress to easy jog. Focus on upright posture, midfoot strike, and comfortable breathing.

exercises.name: Aqua Walking
exercises.desc: Walk in chest-deep water, maintaining upright posture with arm swing. Increase pace or resistance for greater challenge.

exercises.name: Aqua High Knee March
exercises.desc: March in pool, lifting knees to hip height against water resistance. Maintain balance and upright trunk.

exercises.name: Aqua Squat
exercises.desc: Feet shoulder-width in pool, lower to squat position using water for buoyancy assistance. Drive through heels to return.

exercises.name: Pendulum Exercise
exercises.desc: Lean forward supporting yourself with one hand. Let the affected arm hang freely and swing it in small circles using trunk momentum — not shoulder muscle activation.

exercises.name: Sleeper Stretch
exercises.desc: Side-lying on affected shoulder, elbow at 90°. Use other hand to gently push forearm toward floor, stretching posterior shoulder capsule. Stop at discomfort.

exercises.name: Doorway Chest Stretch
exercises.desc: Stand in doorway, forearm on frame at 90°. Step forward until stretch felt across chest and anterior shoulder. Maintain tall posture.

exercises.name: Scapular Clock
exercises.desc: Move shoulder blade in a full clock motion — up, out, down, in — smoothly and with control. Focuses on scapular motor control and proprioception.

exercises.name: Sidelying External Rotation
exercises.desc: Lie on unaffected side, affected arm elbow at 90°. Rotate forearm toward ceiling against gravity. Control the return slowly.

exercises.name: Shoulder Flexion Wall Slide
exercises.desc: Stand facing wall, hands flat. Slide arms overhead as far as pain-free range allows, then return. Useful early post-surgical rehab.

exercises.name: Scapular Push-Up
exercises.desc: Push-up position (or against wall). Without bending elbows, protract and retract shoulder blades only. Teaches serratus anterior activation.

exercises.name: Quad Set (Isometric)
exercises.desc: Lie flat with affected leg straight. Press knee firmly into surface by contracting quadriceps. Hold, then relax. Safe post-surgery or with acute pain.

exercises.name: Short Arc Quad
exercises.desc: Supine with a rolled towel under the knee. Extend the lower leg to full extension, hold briefly, then lower slowly through limited range.

exercises.name: Straight Leg Raise
exercises.desc: Supine with one knee bent. Lock opposite knee straight and raise leg to 45°. Hold briefly, lower slowly. Maintains quad without knee joint load.

exercises.name: Prone Knee Flexion
exercises.desc: Prone, bend knee toward buttock as far as comfortable, then lower slowly. Progress with ankle weight for resistance.

exercises.name: Step Down (Eccentric)
exercises.desc: Stand on affected leg on a step. Slowly lower the opposite heel toward floor, controlling descent entirely through the working leg. Key eccentric quad loading.

exercises.name: Knee Flexion Stretch (Prone)
exercises.desc: Prone, loop a towel around ankle and gently pull heel toward buttock. Steady pressure without bouncing. Restores post-op ROM.

exercises.name: Hip Abduction (Sidelying)
exercises.desc: Lie on side, body straight. Lift top leg to 40° keeping toes forward and hip not rolling back. Lower with control.

exercises.name: Hip Adduction (Sidelying)
exercises.desc: Lie on side, top leg supported on chair or bent forward. Lift bottom leg upward. Targets often-neglected hip adductors.

exercises.name: Hip Internal Rotation (Seated)
exercises.desc: Seated, feet together. Rotate one knee outward (hip internally rotates) against band resistance. Control return.

exercises.name: Hip Extension (Prone)
exercises.desc: Prone, contract glute and lift one leg straight off surface keeping pelvis stable. Hold briefly at top.

exercises.name: Supine Hip Flexion (Active)
exercises.desc: Supine, lift one knee toward chest maintaining neutral pelvis. Lower slowly. Restores flexor strength post hip surgery.

exercises.name: Ankle Alphabet
exercises.desc: Seated, leg outstretched. Draw each letter of the alphabet with the big toe by moving the ankle only. Improves ROM and proprioception.

exercises.name: Ankle Dorsiflexion (Band)
exercises.desc: Band around midfoot fixed behind. Pull foot toward shin against resistance, then return slowly. Essential for ankle sprain and Achilles rehab.

exercises.name: Heel Raises on Step (Eccentric)
exercises.desc: Stand on step edge. Rise on both feet, then lower on one foot slowly below step level. Eccentric loading protocol for Achilles tendinopathy.

exercises.name: Towel Scrunches
exercises.desc: Seated, towel on floor. Use toes to scrunch it toward you. Strengthens intrinsic foot muscles and plantar fascia.

exercises.name: Single Leg Calf Raise (Slow)
exercises.desc: Single leg, rise over 3 counts, hold 2s at top, lower over 3 counts. Use support for balance. Key loading protocol for Achilles.

exercises.name: Sit-to-Stand (Fast)
exercises.desc: Sit at chair edge. Stand as quickly and safely as possible. Builds explosive power essential for fall recovery reactions.

exercises.name: Stepping in Place (Marching)
exercises.desc: March in place lifting knees high with exaggerated arm swing. Focus on rhythm and coordination. Progress tempo gradually.

exercises.name: Lateral Step-Out
exercises.desc: Step one foot out to the side, bring feet together, repeat. Move along a line. Builds lateral stability and reactive stepping.

exercises.name: Over-the-Object Step
exercises.desc: Step over a cone or low object forward then backward, leading with each foot. Builds obstacle navigation confidence and dynamic balance.

exercises.name: Dual-Task Balance
exercises.desc: Stand on one leg while performing a cognitive task (count backwards, name words). Trains the cognitive-motor integration that governs fall risk.

exercises.name: RPE Walk (Cardiac)
exercises.desc: Walk at 11–13/20 RPE — comfortable, conversational pace. Monitor for symptoms: stop if chest pain, dizziness or severe dyspnoea. Build duration 1–2 min per week.

exercises.name: Seated Arm Ergometer
exercises.desc: Pedal arm ergometer at low resistance. Maintain controlled breathing. Avoid Valsalva maneuver. Target 40–60% HRmax.

exercises.name: Low-Load Resistance (Cardiac)
exercises.desc: Light resistance at high reps and slow cadence. Exhale on exertion, avoid breath-holding. Monitor HR and symptoms throughout.

exercises.name: Seated Marching (Cardiac)
exercises.desc: Seated, alternate lifting knees rhythmically. Safe low-demand cardiovascular stimulus for early cardiac rehab or very deconditioned patients.

exercises.name: Paced Walking (Chronic Pain)
exercises.desc: Walk at a pace set below pain threshold. Gradually increase duration each session by a small fixed amount regardless of symptom changes that day.

exercises.name: Breathing with Movement
exercises.desc: Coordinate gentle movement (e.g. arm raises) with slow breath cycles. Exhale on effort. Calms sympathetic nervous system and reduces central sensitisation.

exercises.name: Progressive Muscle Relaxation
exercises.desc: Systematically tense then release major muscle groups from feet to head. Hold tension 5s, release 15s. Reduces muscle guarding and pain-related hypervigilance.

exercises.name: Gaze Stabilisation (VOR)
exercises.desc: Fix eyes on a stationary target. Move head side-to-side while keeping the target in sharp focus. Progress speed gradually. Trains vestibulo-ocular reflex.

exercises.name: Brandt-Daroff Exercises
exercises.desc: Sit upright, rapidly lie on side with head turned 45° to affected side. Hold 30s or until dizziness stops. Return to upright then repeat on other side.

exercises.name: Head Turns (Seated)
exercises.desc: Seated, slowly turn head side-to-side then up and down. Progress to standing. Targets vestibular habituation and motion tolerance.

exercises.name: Tandem Stance on Foam
exercises.desc: Stand heel-to-toe on foam mat, eyes open then closed. Challenges vestibular, proprioceptive and visual balance systems simultaneously.

exercises.name: Gentle Seated Movement (Cancer)
exercises.desc: Slow seated movements through comfortable range — gentle neck rolls, seated trunk rotation, shoulder circles. Focus on breath and body awareness with activity pacing.

exercises.name: Energy-Paced Walk
exercises.desc: Walk at RPE 10–12. Stop before onset of fatigue. Gradually builds aerobic capacity while respecting post-exertional malaise and treatment-related fatigue.

exercises.name: Light Resistance Band (Cancer)
exercises.desc: Light band at slow cadence, focusing on breath control and movement quality. Terminate before significant fatigue onset.

exercises.name: Diaphragmatic Breathing (Lymph)
exercises.desc: Slow diaphragmatic breathing stimulates thoracic duct and promotes central lymphatic flow. Hand on belly to monitor diaphragmatic movement.

exercises.name: Arm Elevation Pumping
exercises.desc: Elevate arm overhead. Repeatedly open and close fist. Gravity-assisted lymph drainage combined with muscle pump activation.

exercises.name: Ankle Pumps (Lymph)
exercises.desc: Supine or seated. Rapidly pump ankles up and down. Activates calf muscle pump to drive lymphatic and venous return.

exercises.name: Pursed Lip Breathing Walk
exercises.desc: Walk at comfortable pace. Inhale through nose for 2 steps, exhale through pursed lips for 4 steps. Maintains positive airway pressure during exertion.

exercises.name: Inspiratory Muscle Training
exercises.desc: Use IMT device (e.g. Threshold) at 30–40% of MIP. Breathe through device for set reps. Progressively strengthens respiratory muscles.

exercises.name: Active Cycle of Breathing
exercises.desc: Sequence: breathing control → thoracic expansion exercises → forced expiration (huffing). Effective airway clearance for COPD and bronchiectasis.

exercises.name: Pelvic Floor Contraction
exercises.desc: Identify pelvic floor muscles as if stopping urine flow. Contract upward and inward, hold, then fully relax. Avoid contracting buttocks or thighs.

exercises.name: Pelvic Floor Quick Flicks
exercises.desc: Rapidly contract and release pelvic floor muscles. Trains fast-twitch fibres for cough and sneeze reflex control and prevention of stress incontinence.

exercises.name: Pelvic Floor with Squat
exercises.desc: Perform a bodyweight squat while maintaining pelvic floor contraction through descent, releasing at the top. Functional integration of pelvic floor with load.

exercises.name: Putty Squeeze
exercises.desc: Knead therapeutic putty using full hand, pinch between fingers, or roll between palms. Select resistance appropriate to hand strength and diagnosis.

exercises.name: Finger Tendon Glides
exercises.desc: Move hand through four positions: straight, hook fist, full fist, tabletop. Hold briefly at each. Maintains tendon excursion post injury or surgery.

exercises.name: Opposition Exercises
exercises.desc: Touch tip of each finger to the thumb in sequence, then reverse. Progress speed. Restores fine motor coordination post nerve injury or surgery.

exercises.name: Cervical Rotation Stretch
exercises.desc: Gently turn head to one side to comfortable end range, hold, return to neutral. Move slowly and within pain-free range at all times.

exercises.name: Cervical Lateral Flexion
exercises.desc: Tilt ear toward shoulder without raising the shoulder. May apply gentle overpressure with same-side hand for a mild end-range stretch.

exercises.name: Neck Isometric (Side)
exercises.desc: Hand against temple, resist head lateral flexion without any movement. Equal and opposite force. Safe cervical strengthening post whiplash.

exercises.name: Upper Trap Stretch
exercises.desc: Seated, hold chair edge with one hand. Tilt head to opposite side and slightly forward. Targets upper trapezius and levator scapulae.

exercises.name: Graded Motor Imagery
exercises.desc: Observe images of body parts and identify left or right (laterality recognition). Progresses to mental imagery of movement. Targets cortical reorganisation in chronic pain.

exercises.name: Theraband Bicep Curl
exercises.desc: Anchor theraband underfoot. Curl hands to shoulders keeping elbows tucked.

exercises.name: Theraband Shoulder Press
exercises.desc: Stand on band. Press hands overhead from shoulder height.

exercises.name: Theraband Row
exercises.desc: Anchor band at chest height. Pull handles to sides of chest squeezing shoulder blades.

exercises.name: Theraband Lateral Raise
exercises.desc: Stand on band. Raise arms to shoulder height with slight elbow bend.

exercises.name: Chair Squat
exercises.desc: Stand in front of chair. Lower until you just touch the seat then stand.

exercises.name: Step Ups
exercises.desc: Step up onto a stair leading with one foot. Alternate legs.

exercises.name: Seated Marching
exercises.desc: Sit tall. Lift alternate knees as if marching in place.

exercises.name: Doorway Shoulder Stretch
exercises.desc: Place forearm on doorframe. Rotate body away to feel stretch across chest and shoulder.

exercises.name: Prone Hip Extension
exercises.desc: Lie face down. Lift one leg keeping knee straight and pelvis flat.

exercises.name: Cat Cow Stretch
exercises.desc: On hands and knees. Alternate arching and rounding spine with breath.

exercises.name: Hip 90/90 Stretch
exercises.desc: Sit with both legs at 90 degrees. Rotate torso over front leg.

exercises.name: Thoracic Rotation Stretch
exercises.desc: Side lying with knees bent. Rotate top arm to opposite side opening chest.

exercises.name: Ankle Circles
exercises.desc: Seated. Lift foot and draw circles with toes. Clockwise then anti-clockwise.

exercises.name: Cervical Lateral Flexion Stretch
exercises.desc: Sit tall. Tilt ear to shoulder gently. Hold.

exercises.name: Wrist Flexor Stretch
exercises.desc: Extend arm with palm up. Gently pull fingers back with other hand.

exercises.name: Wrist Extensor Stretch
exercises.desc: Extend arm with palm down. Gently press hand downward.

exercises.name: Pigeon Stretch
exercises.desc: From plank position, bring one knee forward. Lower hips toward floor.

exercises.name: Posterior Shoulder Capsule Stretch
exercises.desc: Bring one arm across chest. Use other arm to pull elbow gently.

exercises.name: Lumbar Rotation Stretch
exercises.desc: Lie on back. Drop both knees to one side keeping shoulders flat.

exercises.name: Tandem Stance
exercises.desc: Stand with one foot directly in front of the other. Hold 30 seconds.

exercises.name: Timed Up and Go (TUG)
exercises.desc: From seated: stand, walk 3m, turn, walk back, sit. Time the task.

exercises.name: Step Over Obstacle
exercises.desc: Walk toward a small obstacle and step over it without breaking stride.

exercises.name: Backwards Walking
exercises.desc: Walk backwards in a straight line over 3-5 metres.

exercises.name: Star Excursion Balance
exercises.desc: Stand on one leg. Reach other foot in 8 directions without touching floor.

exercises.name: Foam Pad Standing
exercises.desc: Stand on foam pad with feet together. Maintain balance for set time.

exercises.name: Gait Training
exercises.desc: Walk with deliberate heel-toe pattern. Swing arms. Look forward.

exercises.name: Paced Walking
exercises.desc: Walk at comfortable pace. Stop BEFORE pain onset. Gradually increase distance.

exercises.name: Relaxation Breathing
exercises.desc: Inhale 4 counts. Hold 4 counts. Exhale 6 counts. Repeat.

exercises.name: Warm Water Exercise
exercises.desc: Gentle movement in warm water. Buoyancy reduces joint load.

exercises.name: Heel Drops
exercises.desc: Rise onto toes then let heels drop firmly to floor. Creates impact stimulus.

exercises.name: Weighted Vest Walk
exercises.desc: Walk for set time wearing a weighted vest. Maintains loading stimulus.

exercises.name: Impact Stepping
exercises.desc: Step up and down from low step with moderate impact through heel.

exercises.name: Loaded Carry
exercises.desc: Carry a weight in one or both hands while walking. Loads spine and hips.

exercises.name: Rotator Cuff Strengthening (ER)
exercises.desc: Elbow at side bent 90°. Rotate hand outward against theraband resistance.

exercises.name: Rotator Cuff Strengthening (IR)
exercises.desc: Elbow at side bent 90°. Rotate hand inward against theraband resistance.

exercises.name: Shoulder Flexion (Theraband)
exercises.desc: Stand on band. Raise arm forward to shoulder height. Slow and controlled.

exercises.name: Wrist Extension Strengthening
exercises.desc: Forearm supported. Hold light weight and raise hand upward.

exercises.name: Wrist Flexion Strengthening
exercises.desc: Forearm supported palm up. Curl weight upward.

exercises.name: Finger Extension Band
exercises.desc: Place rubber band around fingers. Spread fingers against resistance.

exercises.name: Elbow Flexion Eccentric
exercises.desc: Curl weight up with both hands. Lower slowly with one hand over 4 counts.

exercises.name: Tricep Dips
exercises.desc: Hands on bench behind you. Dip body down bending elbows. Push back up.

exercises.name: Scapular Protraction/Retraction
exercises.desc: Arms forward. Push hands further away rounding upper back. Then pull back squeezing blades.

exercises.name: Shoulder Shrug
exercises.desc: Hold weights at sides. Shrug shoulders toward ears. Hold. Release.

exercises.name: Lateral Band Walk
exercises.desc: Band around ankles. Step side to side maintaining slight squat.

exercises.name: Hamstring Curl (Prone)
exercises.desc: Lie face down. Curl heel toward buttocks against theraband.

exercises.name: Hip Adductor Squeeze
exercises.desc: Lie on back knees bent. Squeeze ball between knees. Hold.

exercises.name: Standing Hip Abduction
exercises.desc: Stand holding support. Lift leg out to side keeping pelvis level.

exercises.name: Ankle Plantarflexion Strengthening
exercises.desc: Seated. Loop band over foot. Point foot down against resistance.

exercises.name: Ankle Dorsiflexion Strengthening
exercises.desc: Seated. Band anchored ahead. Pull foot up against resistance.

exercises.name: Reverse Lunge
exercises.desc: Step back into lunge. Lower back knee toward floor. Drive forward to start.

exercises.name: Side Lying Hip Extension
exercises.desc: Lie on side. Extend top leg back keeping hip neutral.

exercises.name: Stationary Bike
exercises.desc: Cycle at moderate intensity maintaining comfortable resistance.

exercises.name: Recumbent Bike
exercises.desc: Seated cycling with back support. Low joint stress.

exercises.name: Nordic Walking
exercises.desc: Walk using poles for additional upper body engagement and stability.

exercises.name: Pelvic Clock
exercises.desc: Lie on back knees bent. Tilt pelvis as if a clock on belly. Move 12-6 then 3-9.

exercises.name: Spine Stretch Forward
exercises.desc: Sit tall legs extended. Reach arms forward curling spine. Return.

exercises.name: Side Lying Leg Lift Series
exercises.desc: Lie on side. Lift top leg to hip height. Add circles, kicks, and lifts.

exercises.name: Chest Lift
exercises.desc: Lie on back knees bent. Curl chest up keeping neck long. Lower slowly.

exercises.name: Leg Pull Front
exercises.desc: Plank position. Lift one leg keeping hips level. Alternate.

exercises.name: Hundreds (Modified)
exercises.desc: Lie on back. Lift head and arms. Pump arms 100 times with breath.

exercises.name: Side Bend
exercises.desc: Side plank on hand or elbow. Lift hips. Lower and repeat.

exercises.name: Pool Walking
exercises.desc: Walk forward and backward in waist-deep water. Use water resistance.

exercises.name: Aqua Jogging
exercises.desc: Jog in deep water with flotation belt. High cardio low impact.

exercises.name: Pool Wall Push Off
exercises.desc: Stand facing pool wall. Push away gently. Return with controlled flutter kick.

exercises.name: Aqua Arm Circles
exercises.desc: Submerge arms. Circle forward and backward against water resistance.

exercises.name: Hip Flexion in Water
exercises.desc: Hold pool edge. March knees up against water resistance.

exercises.name: Pool Side Steps
exercises.desc: Step sideways through water in waist depth. Resistance trains abductors.

exercises.name: McGill Bird Dog
exercises.desc: On hands and knees. Extend opposite arm and leg. Hold. Return slowly.

exercises.name: McGill Side Bridge
exercises.desc: Side plank on elbow and knees (modified) or feet. Hold.

exercises.name: Ab Wheel Rollout
exercises.desc: Kneel with wheel. Roll forward keeping core braced. Return.

exercises.name: Hollow Body Hold
exercises.desc: Lie on back. Press lower back flat. Extend arms and legs off floor.

exercises.name: Footwork - Parallel
exercises.desc: Lie on reformer. Feet hip-width on footbar. Press out and return. Keep pelvis neutral and core engaged.

exercises.name: Footwork - Pilates V
exercises.desc: Heels together toes apart on footbar. Press out and return. Focus on inner thigh connection.

exercises.name: Footwork - Wide V
exercises.desc: Feet wide apart on footbar in turnout. Press out engaging outer hips.

exercises.name: Footwork - Heels
exercises.desc: Heels on footbar, toes lifted. Press out and return. Strengthens calves and hamstrings.

exercises.name: Footwork - Arches
exercises.desc: Arches of feet on footbar. Requires strong ankle stability and foot intrinsic activation.

exercises.name: Hundred on Reformer
exercises.desc: Lie supine, legs in tabletop. Pump arms 100 times matching breath. Maintain deep abdominal connection.

exercises.name: Leg Circles on Reformer
exercises.desc: Feet in straps. Circle legs maintaining stable pelvis. Reverse direction.

exercises.name: Short Spine
exercises.desc: Feet in straps. Roll spine up bringing knees to chest then extend legs overhead. Slowly roll down.

exercises.name: Coordination
exercises.desc: Lie supine. Extend arms and legs simultaneously. Open and close legs then return. Demands full body control.

exercises.name: Elephant
exercises.desc: Stand on carriage, hands on footbar. Round spine. Push carriage out and pull in with hamstrings.

exercises.name: Down Stretch
exercises.desc: Kneel on carriage, hands on footbar. Push back into extension while maintaining strong abdominals.

exercises.name: Up Stretch
exercises.desc: Pike position. Push carriage back lengthening spine. Return drawing navel in.

exercises.name: Long Stretch
exercises.desc: Plank position on reformer. Push and pull carriage maintaining rigid trunk.

exercises.name: Knee Stretch - Round
exercises.desc: Kneel on carriage spine rounded. Pull knees toward chest and extend. Articulate lumbar spine.

exercises.name: Knee Stretch - Arch
exercises.desc: Kneel on carriage spine in extension. Push and pull maintaining neutral curve.

exercises.name: Running on Reformer
exercises.desc: Supine, feet on footbar. Alternate heel lowering simulating running motion. Mobilises ankles.

exercises.name: Pelvic Lift on Reformer
exercises.desc: Bridge position with feet on footbar. Lift and lower hips maintaining alignment.

exercises.name: Side Lying Leg Series
exercises.desc: Side lying on carriage. Lift and lower top leg. Add variations - forward/back, circles.

exercises.name: Mermaid on Reformer
exercises.desc: Seated sideways. Reach over in lateral flexion using arm to push/pull carriage.

exercises.name: Rowing - Front
exercises.desc: Seated, straps in hands. Round forward then open arms wide pressing back.

exercises.name: Rowing - Back
exercises.desc: Seated, straps in hands behind. Extend arms back then round forward reaching.

exercises.name: Chest Expansion
exercises.desc: Kneeling, straps in hands. Pull arms back opening chest. Hold. Return.

exercises.name: Hug a Tree
exercises.desc: Seated, arms open wide with straps. Pull arms in front of body maintaining open chest.

exercises.name: Salute
exercises.desc: Kneeling, straps in hands at shoulders. Press arms up overhead maintaining stable trunk.

exercises.name: Bicep Curl on Reformer
exercises.desc: Seated or kneeling. Curl straps to shoulders. Control the lowering phase.

exercises.name: Tricep Press on Reformer
exercises.desc: Seated, elbows bent with straps. Extend arms pressing back. Control return.

exercises.name: Teaser on Reformer
exercises.desc: Supine, feet in straps. Roll up to V-sit while extending legs simultaneously.

exercises.name: Long Box Pulling Straps
exercises.desc: Prone on long box. Pull straps back lifting chest. Strengthens back extensors.

exercises.name: Long Box T Pull
exercises.desc: Prone, arms reach forward. Pull straps to T position squeezing shoulder blades.

exercises.name: Breaststroke on Reformer
exercises.desc: Prone. Coordinate arm and leg extension then circle arms around. Demands full posterior chain.

exercises.name: Short Box - Round Back
exercises.desc: Seated on box. Round spine and roll back. Return stacking vertebrae.

exercises.name: Short Box - Flat Back
exercises.desc: Seated, hinge back from hips maintaining neutral spine. Return tall.

exercises.name: Short Box - Side Reach
exercises.desc: Seated on box. Reach arm over in lateral flexion. Alternate sides.

exercises.name: Short Box - Twist
exercises.desc: Seated, rotate torso and reach. Maintain hip stability throughout.

exercises.name: Arabesque on Reformer
exercises.desc: Standing on carriage, hands on footbar. Extend one leg back into arabesque. Balance and control.

exercises.name: Splits on Reformer
exercises.desc: Front foot on footbar, back foot on carriage. Lower into split position controlling carriage.

exercises.name: Knee to Chest on Reformer
exercises.desc: Supine. Draw one knee to chest then extend. Alternate. Mobilises hip flexors.

exercises.name: Hip Abduction in Straps
exercises.desc: Supine, feet in straps. Open legs wide against resistance. Return.

exercises.name: Hip Adduction in Straps
exercises.desc: Supine, feet in straps open wide. Squeeze legs together against resistance.

exercises.name: Frog in Straps
exercises.desc: Supine, heels together toes apart in straps. Extend legs out at angle and return.

exercises.name: Tendon Stretch
exercises.desc: Standing on footbar, lower heels below bar. Lift and lower. Eccentric calf strengthening.

exercises.name: Snake and Twist
exercises.desc: Advanced. Plank to side plank to pike and return. Full body rotation control.

exercises.name: Scooter on Reformer
exercises.desc: Standing, one foot on carriage. Push carriage back balancing on standing leg.

exercises.name: Kneeling Side Kick
exercises.desc: Kneeling sideways on carriage. Kick top leg forward and back controlling carriage.

exercises.name: Backstroke on Reformer
exercises.desc: Supine. Coordinate arms and legs in backstroke pattern. Full body coordination.

exercises.name: Stomach Massage - Round
exercises.desc: Seated on footbar edge, spine rounded. Push carriage out and return.

exercises.name: Stomach Massage - Reach
exercises.desc: Seated upright arms reaching overhead. Push and pull carriage maintaining tall spine.

exercises.name: Chest Lift on Reformer
exercises.desc: Supine, straps behind head. Curl chest up maintaining lower back contact.

exercises.name: Rotation on Reformer
exercises.desc: Supine, chest lifted. Rotate elbow to opposite knee. Oblique focus.

exercises.name: Control Balance
exercises.desc: Advanced. Roll over to shoulders, balance and extend one leg up. Control spine throughout.

exercises.name: Standing Quad Stretch
exercises.desc: Stand on one leg. Pull heel to buttock. Hold upright posture. Use wall for balance if needed.

exercises.name: Supine Hamstring Stretch
exercises.desc: Lie on back. Lift one leg and hold behind thigh. Gently straighten knee until stretch felt.

exercises.name: Seated Hamstring Stretch
exercises.desc: Sit with one leg extended. Lean forward reaching toward foot. Keep back straight.

exercises.name: Hip Flexor Lunge Stretch
exercises.desc: Kneeling lunge. Drive hips forward feeling stretch in front hip. Keep upright posture.

exercises.name: Butterfly Stretch
exercises.desc: Sit with feet together. Let knees fall out. Lean forward gently pressing knees down.

exercises.name: Figure Four Stretch
exercises.desc: Lie on back. Cross ankle over opposite knee. Pull both legs toward chest.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Stretch
exercises.desc: Hands on wall. Step back with one foot. Press heel to floor. Lean forward.

exercises.name: Soleus Stretch
exercises.desc: Step back with one foot. Bend that knee toward floor keeping heel down. Targets lower calf.

exercises.name: Child Pose
exercises.desc: Kneel and sit back toward heels. Reach arms forward lowering chest to floor.

exercises.name: Thread the Needle
exercises.desc: On hands and knees. Slide one arm under body rotating thoracic spine. Hold.

exercises.name: Pec Stretch at Wall
exercises.desc: Place forearm on wall at 90°. Rotate body away feeling stretch across chest.

exercises.name: Cross Body Shoulder Stretch
exercises.desc: Pull one arm across chest using other arm. Hold. Keep shoulder down.

exercises.name: Overhead Tricep Stretch
exercises.desc: Reach one arm overhead. Bend elbow behind head. Push gently with other hand.

exercises.name: Neck Flexion Stretch
exercises.desc: Gently drop chin to chest. Place hands on back of head for gentle overpressure.

exercises.name: Neck Extension Stretch
exercises.desc: Gently look up toward ceiling. Do not compress cervical spine.

exercises.name: Upper Trapezius Stretch
exercises.desc: Tilt ear to shoulder. Gently apply pressure with same-side hand. Keep opposite shoulder down.

exercises.name: Levator Scapulae Stretch
exercises.desc: Look down toward armpit. Gently apply pressure to top of head.

exercises.name: Thoracic Extension over Foam Roller
exercises.desc: Place foam roller horizontally under mid back. Support head. Gently extend over roller.

exercises.name: Seated Piriformis Stretch
exercises.desc: Seated in chair. Cross ankle over knee. Lean forward keeping back straight.

exercises.name: Low Back Rotation Stretch
exercises.desc: Lie on back knees bent. Drop both knees to one side. Keep shoulders flat.

exercises.name: Knee to Chest Stretch
exercises.desc: Lie on back. Pull one knee toward chest with both hands. Hold.

exercises.name: Double Knee to Chest
exercises.desc: Lie on back. Pull both knees to chest hugging them. Rock gently.

exercises.name: Supine IT Band Stretch
exercises.desc: Lie on back. Cross one leg over midline pressing knee down with opposite hand.

exercises.name: Standing IT Band Stretch
exercises.desc: Cross one leg behind other. Lean to standing side. Feel stretch in hip of crossed leg.

exercises.name: Lat Stretch at Doorway
exercises.desc: Hold doorframe at shoulder height. Sit back and drop hips. Feel stretch down side.

exercises.name: Prone Cobra Stretch
exercises.desc: Lie face down. Press up onto elbows or hands. Let hips drop. Breathe.

exercises.name: Side-Lying Quad Stretch
exercises.desc: Lie on side. Pull top heel to buttock. Push hip forward to intensify.

exercises.name: Half-Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch
exercises.desc: Kneeling lunge. Tuck pelvis under and squeeze glute. Drive hips forward.

exercises.name: Worlds Greatest Stretch
exercises.desc: Lunge with front foot. Drop same-side hand inside foot. Rotate upper body reaching to ceiling.

exercises.name: Ankle Dorsiflexion Stretch
exercises.desc: Lunge with knee tracking over foot. Push knee forward past toes. Increases ankle mobility.

exercises.name: Neck Rotation Stretch
exercises.desc: Slowly rotate head to look over shoulder. Hold. Return and repeat other side.

exercises.name: Shoulder Capsule Stretch
exercises.desc: Reach arm across chest. Use opposite arm to press elbow toward body.

exercises.name: Prayer Stretch
exercises.desc: Kneel, sit back and reach arms forward as far as possible on floor.

exercises.name: Seated Spinal Twist
exercises.desc: Sit with one leg extended, other foot outside opposite knee. Rotate toward bent knee.

exercises.name: Standing Side Stretch
exercises.desc: Reach one arm overhead. Lean to opposite side. Feel stretch down entire side body.

exercises.name: Cat Stretch
exercises.desc: On hands and knees. Round spine fully upward. Hold then release. Mobilises thoracic and lumbar.

exercises.name: Cow Stretch
exercises.desc: On hands and knees. Drop belly toward floor arching spine. Look forward.

exercises.name: Groin Stretch - Sumo Squat
exercises.desc: Wide stance squat. Push knees out with elbows. Hold deep position.

exercises.name: Forearm and Bicep Stretch
exercises.desc: Extend arms forward palms up. Rotate palms to face down and away. Hold.

exercises.name: Standing Piriformis Stretch
exercises.desc: Cross one ankle over bent knee. Sit back into a squat position. Hold.

exercises.name: Banded Hamstring Stretch
exercises.desc: Lie on back. Loop band around foot. Straighten leg pulling with band. Keep pelvis flat.

exercises.name: Adductor Stretch - Side Lunge
exercises.desc: Lateral lunge. Sit into one hip keeping opposite leg straight. Feel inner thigh stretch.

exercises.name: Spinal Flexion Stretch
exercises.desc: Seated. Round entire spine forward reaching hands toward feet. Breathe into back.

exercises.name: Thoracic Rotation in Sitting
exercises.desc: Sit in chair, arms folded. Rotate as far as comfortable. Hold. Return.

exercises.name: Standing Hip Flexor Stretch
exercises.desc: Stand tall. Pull one heel to opposite hand behind body extending hip.

exercises.name: Chest Opening Stretch
exercises.desc: Clasp hands behind back. Squeeze shoulder blades. Lift arms slightly. Hold.

exercises.name: Posterior Chain Stretch
exercises.desc: Stand and hinge forward. Let arms hang. Gently bend and straighten knees alternately.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Squat
exercises.desc: Stand feet shoulder-width. Lower hips back and down until thighs parallel. Drive through heels.

exercises.name: Donkey Kick
exercises.desc: On hands and knees. Kick one heel toward ceiling keeping knee bent. Squeeze glute at top.

exercises.name: Fire Hydrant
exercises.desc: On hands and knees. Lift one knee out to side keeping bend. Activate outer glute.

exercises.name: Wall Sit
exercises.desc: Back against wall. Lower into squat position with thighs parallel. Hold.

exercises.name: Side Lunge
exercises.desc: Step wide to one side. Sit into hip keeping opposite leg straight. Return.

exercises.name: Sumo Squat
exercises.desc: Wide stance toes out. Squat keeping knees tracking over toes.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise
exercises.desc: Rise onto toes. Hold at top. Lower slowly. Use wall for balance.

exercises.name: Single Leg Calf Raise
exercises.desc: Balance on one leg. Rise onto toes. Lower slowly. Increases challenge.

exercises.name: Incline Push Up
exercises.desc: Hands on bench or couch. Body at angle. Lower chest to surface. Push up.

exercises.name: Decline Push Up
exercises.desc: Feet elevated on chair. Hands on floor. More upper chest and shoulder activation.

exercises.name: Diamond Push Up
exercises.desc: Hands close together forming diamond. Targets triceps more than standard push up.

exercises.name: Pike Push Up
exercises.desc: Hips high in pike position. Lower head toward floor. Targets shoulders.

exercises.name: Spiderman Plank
exercises.desc: In plank bring one knee to elbow. Alternate sides. Challenges core and hip flexors.

exercises.name: Plank with Shoulder Tap
exercises.desc: In plank tap opposite shoulder with each hand. Minimise hip rotation.

exercises.name: Superman
exercises.desc: Lie face down. Lift arms and legs simultaneously. Hold at top.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Raise
exercises.desc: Sit in chair. Straighten one leg and hold. Lower slowly.

exercises.name: Seated Toe Taps
exercises.desc: Sit in chair. Tap toes on floor alternately in marching pattern.

exercises.name: Heel Raises Seated
exercises.desc: Seated. Lift both heels off floor. Hold. Lower slowly.

exercises.name: Chair Dips
exercises.desc: Hands on chair edge. Dip body down bending elbows. Push back up.

exercises.name: Towel Row
exercises.desc: Wrap towel around door handle. Lean back and row body toward door.

exercises.name: Doorframe Pull
exercises.desc: Hold doorframe at sides. Lean back and pull chest toward frame.

exercises.name: Backpack Bicep Curl
exercises.desc: Fill backpack with books. Hold handles and perform bicep curl.

exercises.name: Hip Hinge
exercises.desc: Stand with slight knee bend. Hinge forward at hips keeping back straight. Return.

exercises.name: Single Leg Balance
exercises.desc: Stand on one leg. Maintain balance for set time. Progress to eyes closed.

exercises.name: Tandem Walking
exercises.desc: Walk heel to toe in a straight line. Arms out for balance.

exercises.name: Standing March
exercises.desc: March on spot lifting knees to hip height. Swing opposite arm.

exercises.name: High Knees
exercises.desc: Run on spot bringing knees to hip height. Maintain upright posture.

exercises.name: Stair Climbing
exercises.desc: Walk up and down stairs continuously. Maintain good posture.

exercises.name: Towel Hamstring Curl
exercises.desc: Lie on smooth floor with towel under heels. Slide heels toward buttocks.

exercises.name: Standing Hip Circles
exercises.desc: Hold wall. Draw large circles with raised knee. Mobilises hip joint.

exercises.name: Standing Shoulder Press with Can
exercises.desc: Hold tins of food. Press overhead from shoulder height. Control lowering.

exercises.name: Chest Press with Water Bottles
exercises.desc: Lie on floor. Press water bottles up from chest. Lower slowly.

exercises.name: Seated Resistance Band Rowing
exercises.desc: Sit on floor. Band around feet. Row hands to sides of chest.

exercises.name: Crab Walk
exercises.desc: Band around ankles in mini squat. Step sideways maintaining tension.

exercises.name: Monster Walk
exercises.desc: Band around ankles. Walk forward in wide stance. Maintain hip hinge position.

exercises.name: Isometric Wall Push
exercises.desc: Stand sideways to wall. Push palm into wall with extended arm. Hold.

exercises.name: Isometric Squat Hold
exercises.desc: Lower to squat position. Hold still. Increases muscular endurance.

exercises.name: Plank to Downward Dog
exercises.desc: Start in plank. Push hips up into downward dog. Return to plank.

exercises.name: Inchworm
exercises.desc: Stand and bend to touch floor. Walk hands out to plank. Walk feet to hands. Stand.

exercises.name: Reverse Nordic Curl
exercises.desc: Kneel with feet anchored. Lean back from knees while maintaining straight hip. Return.

exercises.name: Copenhagen Plank
exercises.desc: Side plank with top foot on chair or couch. Lift bottom leg to meet top.

exercises.name: Box Breathing Exercise
exercises.desc: Inhale 4 counts. Hold 4 counts. Exhale 4 counts. Hold 4 counts. Repeat.

exercises.name: Shoulder Blade Squeeze
exercises.desc: Stand or sit. Squeeze shoulder blades together. Hold. Release. Strengthens postural muscles.

exercises.name: Neck Retraction
exercises.desc: Gently tuck chin in without flexing. Hold. Strengthens deep cervical flexors.

exercises.name: Leg Extension Machine
exercises.desc: Seated, pad against shins. Extend knees to straight. Control lowering.

exercises.name: Leg Curl Machine - Prone
exercises.desc: Lie face down. Curl heels toward buttocks. Control lowering.

exercises.name: Leg Curl Machine - Seated
exercises.desc: Seated. Curl heels under seat. Control the eccentric phase.

exercises.name: Hip Abduction Machine
exercises.desc: Seated, pads against outer thighs. Push legs apart against resistance. Return slowly.

exercises.name: Hip Adduction Machine
exercises.desc: Seated, pads against inner thighs. Squeeze legs together. Control return.

exercises.name: Calf Raise Machine
exercises.desc: Shoulders under pads. Rise onto toes. Lower heels below platform.

exercises.name: Seated Calf Raise Machine
exercises.desc: Pads on thighs. Rise onto toes. Targets soleus more than standing variation.

exercises.name: Chest Press Machine
exercises.desc: Seated, handles at chest. Push forward until arms extended. Control return.

exercises.name: Pec Deck / Chest Fly Machine
exercises.desc: Seated, arms open. Bring arms together in front. Squeeze chest.

exercises.name: Shoulder Press Machine
exercises.desc: Seated, press handles overhead. Control lowering. Keep core engaged.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise Machine
exercises.desc: Seated, pads against arms. Raise arms to shoulder height. Control lowering.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown Machine
exercises.desc: Seated, grip bar wide. Pull bar to upper chest. Control return.

exercises.name: Seated Row Machine
exercises.desc: Seated, pull handles to lower chest. Squeeze shoulder blades.

exercises.name: Cable Row - Low
exercises.desc: Seated at cable. Pull handle to lower chest keeping elbows in.

exercises.name: Cable Row - High
exercises.desc: Pull cable from high position to face level. Targets rear deltoids.

exercises.name: Cable Chest Fly - Low to High
exercises.desc: Pull cables from low to high crossing in front. Targets upper chest.

exercises.name: Cable Chest Fly - High to Low
exercises.desc: Pull cables from high to low crossing in front. Targets lower chest.

exercises.name: Cable Bicep Curl
exercises.desc: Stand at cable. Curl bar or rope up to shoulders. Control lowering.

exercises.name: Cable Tricep Pushdown
exercises.desc: Stand at cable, elbows at sides. Push rope down extending arms. Control return.

exercises.name: Cable Lateral Raise
exercises.desc: Stand side-on to cable. Raise arm out to side to shoulder height.

exercises.name: Cable Face Pull
exercises.desc: Pull rope to face level flaring elbows out. Targets rear deltoids and rotator cuff.

exercises.name: Cable Pull Through
exercises.desc: Stand facing away from cable. Hinge forward pulling cable between legs. Hip hinge pattern.

exercises.name: Cable Hip Abduction
exercises.desc: Stand side-on to cable attached to ankle. Raise leg out to side.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Squat
exercises.desc: Bar on Smith machine. Squat to parallel. Machine guides vertical bar path.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Lunge
exercises.desc: Bar on Smith machine. Step forward into lunge. Maintain upright torso.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Hip Thrust
exercises.desc: Shoulders on bench. Bar across hips. Drive hips up. Squeeze glutes at top.

exercises.name: Hack Squat Machine
exercises.desc: Shoulders under pads. Squat keeping knees tracking toes. Emphasises quads.

exercises.name: Assisted Pull Up Machine
exercises.desc: Kneel on platform. Pull up to bar. Machine reduces bodyweight needed.

exercises.name: Assisted Dip Machine
exercises.desc: Kneel on platform. Dip by bending elbows. Machine reduces bodyweight.

exercises.name: Rotary Torso Machine
exercises.desc: Seated. Rotate machine against resistance. Trains obliques through rotation.

exercises.name: Ab Crunch Machine
exercises.desc: Seated. Curl torso forward against resistance. Control extension back.

exercises.name: Back Extension Machine
exercises.desc: Seated. Extend spine against resistance. Targets lower back extensors.

exercises.name: Reverse Hyper Machine
exercises.desc: Lie prone. Swing legs up behind engaging glutes and hamstrings.

exercises.name: Pendulum Squat Machine
exercises.desc: Heels elevated on pendulum. Squat through full range. Excellent quad targeting.

exercises.name: Seated Chest Press Machine - Narrow
exercises.desc: Narrow grip on chest press machine. More tricep and inner chest involvement.

exercises.name: Rope Lat Pulldown
exercises.desc: Rope attachment on pulldown. Pull down and apart to shoulders.

exercises.name: Incline Chest Press Machine
exercises.desc: Inclined machine targets upper chest. Press from shoulder to overhead.

exercises.name: Decline Chest Press Machine
exercises.desc: Declined machine targets lower chest. Press from lower chest angle.

exercises.name: Cable Crunch
exercises.desc: Kneel at cable. Pull rope to forehead. Crunch down engaging abs.

exercises.name: Cable Woodchop - High to Low
exercises.desc: Rotate pulling cable from high to low across body. Targets obliques.

exercises.name: Cable Woodchop - Low to High
exercises.desc: Rotate pulling cable from low to high. Reverse woodchop pattern.

exercises.name: Seated Shoulder External Rotation Machine
exercises.desc: Elbow supported. Rotate forearm outward against resistance. Rotator cuff strengthening.

exercises.name: Glute Drive Machine
exercises.desc: Back against pad, bar across hips. Drive hips forward. Targeted glute activation.

exercises.name: Sissy Squat Machine
exercises.desc: Heels elevated, lean back. Squat keeping hips extended. Extreme quad isolation.

exercises.name: Row Machine - Ergometer
exercises.desc: Full body rowing action. Drive with legs, lean back, pull to lower chest.

exercises.name: Ski Erg
exercises.desc: Pull ropes down from overhead in double pole skiing action.

exercises.name: Air Bike
exercises.desc: Push/pull handlebars while pedalling. Full body high intensity cardio.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Press - Single Leg
exercises.desc: One foot on platform. Single leg press. Identifies and corrects strength asymmetry.

exercises.name: Plate Loaded Hip Thrust Machine
exercises.desc: Back on pad, plate loaded across hips. Drive hips to full extension.

exercises.name: Footwork — Parallel Heels
exercises.desc: Lie supine on reformer. Press platform away through heels in parallel. Return with control.

exercises.name: Footwork — Parallel Toes
exercises.desc: Lie supine. Press through balls of feet in parallel position. Heels lifted throughout.

exercises.name: Footwork — V Position
exercises.desc: Heels together toes apart (Pilates V). Press carriage away maintaining turnout.

exercises.name: Footwork — Wide Parallel
exercises.desc: Feet wide apart in parallel. Press through mid foot. Targets inner thighs.

exercises.name: Short Spine Massage
exercises.desc: Loop straps on feet. Roll spine up and over, then slowly articulate vertebra by vertebra back down.

exercises.name: Long Spine Massage
exercises.desc: Like short spine but extended legs. Roll pelvis up, over, and down in one long movement.

exercises.name: Knee Stretch — Round Back
exercises.desc: Kneel on carriage. Round spine, press carriage back with knees. Maintain curl.

exercises.name: Knee Stretch — Arch Back
exercises.desc: Kneel on carriage with arched spine. Press carriage back maintaining extension.

exercises.name: Tree on Reformer
exercises.desc: Supine. One leg extended to ceiling held at ankle. Walk hands up leg, lie back, roll up.

exercises.name: Frog on Reformer
exercises.desc: Supine with feet in straps heels together toes out. Press legs away then bend back in.

exercises.name: Side Splits on Reformer
exercises.desc: Stand sideways on reformer. Push standing platform out to the side. Return using inner thigh.

exercises.name: Front Splits on Reformer
exercises.desc: Lunge position — one foot on carriage, one on platform. Push carriage back into lunge.

exercises.name: Snake on Reformer
exercises.desc: Side plank position on box. Push carriage away, arc through, return.

exercises.name: Tendon Stretch on Reformer
exercises.desc: Stand on platform. Lower heels below edge. Rise onto toes. Control descent.

exercises.name: Chest Expansion on Reformer
exercises.desc: Kneel facing away. Pull handles down by sides. Look right then left. Release.

exercises.name: Thigh Stretch on Reformer
exercises.desc: Kneel upright on carriage. Lean back from knees maintaining alignment. Return.

exercises.name: Arm Circles on Reformer
exercises.desc: Seated or supine. Circle arms with straps maintaining shoulder blade stability.

exercises.name: Hip Rolls on Reformer
exercises.desc: Supine feet on bar. Bridge up, hold, lower. Focus on segmental spinal articulation.

exercises.name: Kneeling Lunge on Reformer
exercises.desc: Kneeling rear lunge with front foot on carriage. Press carriage back stretching hip flexor.

exercises.name: Side Kick Kneeling on Reformer
exercises.desc: Kneel sideways. Kick top leg forward and back maintaining pelvic stability.

exercises.name: Plank to Pike on Reformer
exercises.desc: Feet on carriage in plank. Pike hips to ceiling pulling carriage in. Return.

exercises.name: Reverse Plank on Reformer
exercises.desc: Seated facing away from footbar. Hands on footbar. Lift hips to reverse plank.

exercises.name: Star on Reformer
exercises.desc: Side plank on one hand on platform. Push carriage away with top foot. Lift into star.

exercises.name: Squat on Reformer
exercises.desc: Stand on carriage facing footbar. Squat down and back. Return to standing.

exercises.name: Lunge Series on Reformer
exercises.desc: Step one foot back onto carriage. Lunge forward, press carriage back, return.

exercises.name: Grasshopper on Reformer
exercises.desc: Prone on box. Bend and extend knees using straps. Squeeze glutes throughout.

exercises.name: Swan on Reformer
exercises.desc: Prone on box. Extend spine lifting chest while pressing carriage away.

exercises.name: Balance Control Front on Reformer
exercises.desc: Supine. Roll up, balance on shoulders, lower legs toward platform. Control.

exercises.name: Cardio Jumping on Reformer
exercises.desc: Supine footwork position. Spring jump carriage away and land softly. Continuous rhythm.

exercises.name: Splits on Box — Reformer
exercises.desc: One foot on box one on carriage. Press into splits range. Control return.

exercises.name: Pulling Straps on Box
exercises.desc: Prone on box. Pull straps by sides lifting chest. Arc into extension.

exercises.name: T Pull on Box
exercises.desc: Prone on box arms in T. Pull straps back maintaining T position.

exercises.name: Hamstring Curl on Reformer
exercises.desc: Prone feet in straps. Curl heels toward glutes against spring resistance.

exercises.name: Abdominal Series on Reformer
exercises.desc: Supine. Perform single leg stretch, double leg stretch, and scissors using springs.

exercises.name: Control Push Up on Reformer
exercises.desc: Hands on footbar feet on carriage. Push up then pike hips. Return to plank.

exercises.name: Figure Four Hip Stretch
exercises.desc: Lie on back. Cross ankle over opposite knee. Pull thigh toward chest.

exercises.name: Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch
exercises.desc: Half kneeling. Drive hips forward maintaining upright torso. Feel stretch in front of rear hip.

exercises.name: Butterfly Groin Stretch
exercises.desc: Sit with soles of feet together. Gently press knees toward floor with elbows.

exercises.name: Wide Leg Forward Fold
exercises.desc: Stand with legs wide. Hinge forward folding toward floor. Walk hands between feet.

exercises.name: Seated Glute Stretch
exercises.desc: Sit on floor. Cross one leg in front. Fold forward over crossed leg.

exercises.name: Supine Spinal Twist
exercises.desc: Lie on back. Pull one knee across body to floor. Extend arm in opposite direction.

exercises.name: Chest Doorway Stretch
exercises.desc: Stand in doorway. Forearms on frame. Step through until chest stretch felt.

exercises.name: Pec Minor Stretch
exercises.desc: Arm at 90° on wall, elbow shoulder height. Rotate body away. Feel deep chest stretch.

exercises.name: Latissimus Dorsi Stretch
exercises.desc: Hold doorframe or pole overhead. Lean back and laterally until lat stretch felt.

exercises.name: Chin Tuck Stretch
exercises.desc: Tuck chin to lengthen back of neck. Add gentle overpressure with fingers at base of skull.

exercises.name: Scalene Stretch
exercises.desc: Tilt ear to shoulder. Look slightly up. Depress opposite shoulder actively.

exercises.name: Tibialis Anterior Stretch
exercises.desc: Kneel on floor. Sit back on heels tops of feet flat. Feel stretch down front of shin.

exercises.name: Ankle Plantar Flexion Stretch
exercises.desc: Kneel. Lift one knee and point toes behind. Sit back gently stretching top of foot.

exercises.name: Prone Quad Stretch
exercises.desc: Lie face down. Bend one knee reaching for ankle. Pull gently. Keep hips down.

exercises.name: Runners Lunge Stretch
exercises.desc: Deep lunge position. Lower back knee to floor. Sink hips down. Reach arms up.

exercises.name: Lizard Lunge Stretch
exercises.desc: Deep lunge with front foot outside hand. Drop rear knee. Sink deep into hip.

exercises.name: Standing Figure Four Stretch
exercises.desc: Stand. Cross ankle over opposite thigh. Sit back into single leg squat. Hold chair if needed.

exercises.name: Supine Psoas Stretch
exercises.desc: Lie on edge of table/bed. Hug one knee to chest. Lower other leg off edge.

exercises.name: Wall Calf Stretch
exercises.desc: Stand facing wall. Place ball of foot on wall keeping heel on floor. Lean in.

exercises.name: Forearm Flexor Stretch
exercises.desc: Extend arm palm up. Gently bend wrist back with other hand. Rotate arm slightly.

exercises.name: Prayer Stretch (Wrists)
exercises.desc: Press palms together in prayer position at chest. Lower hands while keeping palms flat.

exercises.name: Doorway Bicep Stretch
exercises.desc: Stand in doorway. Place hand on frame at hip height, thumb down. Turn body away.

exercises.name: Standing Side Bend Stretch
exercises.desc: Stand tall. Reach one arm overhead and bend laterally. Feel stretch along ribs.

exercises.name: Seated Spinal Rotation
exercises.desc: Sit tall with legs extended. Twist torso placing hand behind. Look over shoulder.

exercises.name: Cobra Stretch
exercises.desc: Lie prone. Place hands under shoulders. Straighten arms lifting chest. Hips stay down.

exercises.name: Sphinx Stretch
exercises.desc: Lie prone propped on forearms. Gentle lumbar extension held passively.

exercises.name: Standing Hip Extension Stretch
exercises.desc: Stand. Swing one leg back and hold. Or lunge back and hold at end range.

exercises.name: Supine Knee to Chest
exercises.desc: Lie on back. Pull one or both knees to chest. Rock gently side to side.

exercises.name: Thoracic Extension over Roller
exercises.desc: Lie over foam roller placed horizontally across mid back. Arms overhead. Relax.

exercises.name: Open Book Stretch
exercises.desc: Sidelying knees bent. Rotate top arm to open chest. Follow hand with eyes.

exercises.name: Supine Groin Stretch
exercises.desc: Lie on back. Let one leg fall out to side with bent knee. Feel inner thigh stretch.

exercises.name: Wall Shoulder Stretch
exercises.desc: Stand side on to wall. Place palm on wall. Rotate body away feeling chest and shoulder.

exercises.name: Active Thoracic Rotation
exercises.desc: Sit or stand. Rotate torso maximally each direction holding 3 seconds. Increase range with each rep.

exercises.name: Theraband Squat
exercises.desc: Stand on band. Hold handles at shoulders. Squat keeping chest tall and knees over toes.

exercises.name: Theraband Chest Press
exercises.desc: Anchor band behind at shoulder height. Press forward extending arms. Control return.

exercises.name: Theraband Pull Apart
exercises.desc: Hold band with both hands at chest width. Pull apart stretching band across chest.

exercises.name: Theraband External Rotation Standing
exercises.desc: Band anchored at elbow height. Hold with elbow at side. Rotate arm outward.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Extension (Theraband)
exercises.desc: Anchor band at ankle. Sit in chair. Extend knee against resistance.

exercises.name: Standing Hip Flexion (Theraband)
exercises.desc: Band anchored low behind ankle. Lift knee forward against resistance.

exercises.name: Theraband Deadlift
exercises.desc: Stand on band. Hinge at hips lowering hands toward floor. Drive through heels to return.

exercises.name: Marching Glute Bridge
exercises.desc: In glute bridge position. Alternate lifting each knee maintaining level hips.

exercises.name: Reverse Crunch
exercises.desc: Lie on back. Pull knees to chest lifting hips off floor. Lower with control.

exercises.name: Leg Raises
exercises.desc: Lie on back. Raise both legs to 90° keeping lower back flat. Lower slowly.

exercises.name: Flutter Kicks
exercises.desc: Lie on back legs raised slightly. Alternately kick up and down in small rapid movements.

exercises.name: Scissor Kicks
exercises.desc: Lie on back. Cross legs over each other in scissor motion keeping them elevated.

exercises.name: Mountain Climbers
exercises.desc: In plank position. Alternately drive knees toward chest in running motion.

exercises.name: Burpee (Modified)
exercises.desc: From standing. Squat down place hands on floor. Step or jump feet back to plank. Return.

exercises.name: Jumping Jacks
exercises.desc: Jump feet wide while raising arms overhead. Return to start. Repeat rhythmically.

exercises.name: Lateral Lunge
exercises.desc: Step wide to one side. Bend that knee keeping other leg straight. Push back.

exercises.name: Curtsy Lunge
exercises.desc: Step one foot behind and across to opposite side. Lower knee. Return.

exercises.name: Squat Pulse
exercises.desc: Hold squat at bottom. Pulse up and down in small range for set time.

exercises.name: Good Mornings
exercises.desc: Stand feet hip width. Hinge forward at hips with slight knee bend. Return.

exercises.name: Superman Hold
exercises.desc: Lie prone. Simultaneously lift arms and legs off floor. Hold. Lower with control.

exercises.name: Hip Circles
exercises.desc: Stand with hands on hips. Circle hips in large circle clockwise then anti-clockwise.

exercises.name: Bear Crawl
exercises.desc: On hands and toes with knees hovering. Crawl forward alternating opposite hand and foot.

exercises.name: Donkey Kicks
exercises.desc: On hands and knees. Drive one heel toward ceiling maintaining bent knee.

exercises.name: Standing Kickback
exercises.desc: Hold chair for balance. Swing leg back maintaining straight back. Squeeze glute at top.

exercises.name: Squat to Calf Raise
exercises.desc: Squat down then as you stand rise onto toes at top. Lower heels and repeat.

exercises.name: Alternating Superman
exercises.desc: Prone. Lift opposite arm and leg simultaneously. Alternate sides.

exercises.name: Staggered Push Up
exercises.desc: One hand forward one hand back. Push up then switch hand positions.

exercises.name: Plank Shoulder Taps
exercises.desc: In plank. Alternately tap each shoulder with opposite hand. Minimise hip rotation.

exercises.name: Single Leg Deadlift (Bodyweight)
exercises.desc: Balance on one leg. Hinge forward reaching hands toward floor. Return.

exercises.name: Tricep Bench Dip
exercises.desc: Hands on chair edge behind. Lower body bending elbows. Push back up.

exercises.name: Resistance Band Bicycle
exercises.desc: Band around feet. Lie on back. Pedal legs in bicycle motion against resistance.

exercises.name: Tuck Jumps
exercises.desc: Jump and pull knees to chest at peak of jump. Land softly bending knees.

exercises.name: Lateral Band Walk (Home)
exercises.desc: Band above ankles. Step side to side maintaining slight squat position.

exercises.name: Y-T-W Exercise
exercises.desc: Prone on floor. Lift arms into Y shape then T shape then W shape. Hold each.

exercises.name: Hollow Body Rock
exercises.desc: Lie on back. Press lower back to floor. Arms overhead legs raised. Rock forward and back.

exercises.name: Reverse Hyperextension
exercises.desc: Lie prone on table/bench hips at edge. Lift legs to horizontal. Lower with control.

exercises.name: Leg Press Machine
exercises.desc: Sit in seat. Place feet shoulder width on platform. Press away extending legs. Lower with control.

exercises.name: Leg Curl Machine (Lying)
exercises.desc: Lie prone. Hook ankles over pad. Curl heels toward glutes. Lower with control.

exercises.name: Pec Fly Machine
exercises.desc: Sit with arms out in T position. Bring arms together in front squeezing chest.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
exercises.desc: Sit upright. Pull handles to lower chest. Squeeze shoulder blades. Extend back.

exercises.name: Rear Delt Fly Machine
exercises.desc: Sit facing pad. Grip handles in front. Push arms out and back squeezing rear delts.

exercises.name: Bicep Curl Machine
exercises.desc: Sit with upper arms on pad. Curl handles toward shoulders. Lower with control.

exercises.name: Tricep Extension Machine
exercises.desc: Sit upright. Press handles downward extending elbows. Return with control.

exercises.name: Cable Chest Fly
exercises.desc: Stand between cables set at shoulder height. Pull handles together in front of chest.

exercises.name: Cable Woodchop
exercises.desc: High cable. Pull diagonally downward across body rotating through core.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust on Smith Machine
exercises.desc: Shoulders on bench bar across hips. Drive hips to ceiling squeezing glutes.

exercises.name: Rowing Machine (Cardio)
exercises.desc: Drive with legs first then lean back pulling handle to sternum. Extend forward and repeat.

exercises.name: Assault Bike
exercises.desc: Pedal and push/pull handles simultaneously. High intensity full body cardio.

exercises.name: Treadmill Walking Incline
exercises.desc: Walk on treadmill at 8-12% incline. Maintain upright posture. Do not hold rails.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Bench Press
exercises.desc: Lie on bench. Lower bar to chest in controlled path. Press back up.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Row
exercises.desc: Bend forward gripping bar. Pull bar to lower chest squeezing shoulder blades.

exercises.name: Glute Kickback Machine
exercises.desc: Stand facing machine. Hook ankle into pad. Kick leg back extending hip.

exercises.name: Seated Hip Flexion Machine
exercises.desc: Sit upright. Lift thigh against resistance bringing knee toward chest.

exercises.name: Cable Romanian Deadlift
exercises.desc: Stand facing low cable. Hinge at hips maintaining straight back. Return.

exercises.name: Seated Chest Press Machine (Converging)
exercises.desc: Arcing path brings handles together at end range. Better chest activation.

exercises.name: High Row Machine
exercises.desc: Sit. Pull handles from overhead down to upper chest. Squeeze lats at bottom.

exercises.name: Low Row Machine (Chest Supported)
exercises.desc: Lie prone on chest pad. Row handles toward lower chest. Squeeze scapulae.

exercises.name: Inner/Outer Thigh Machine Combined
exercises.desc: Alternate between abduction and adduction settings. Targets both muscle groups.

exercises.name: Total Gym Squat
exercises.desc: Reclined squat on incline platform. Feet on board. Press to full extension.

exercises.name: Functional Trainer Press
exercises.desc: Dual cables at chest height. Press forward in functional press pattern.

exercises.name: Torso Rotation Machine
exercises.desc: Sit. Rotate torso against resistance. Control both directions equally.

exercises.name: Abdominal Crunch Machine
exercises.desc: Sit. Pull handles/pads curling spine into crunch. Control extension.

exercises.name: Multi Hip Machine
exercises.desc: Four-way hip machine. Train flexion, extension, abduction and adduction in sequence.
